sec.title: Master Undated Resolution Pipeline (Batch 8 of 1,607)
sec.p: Continuing **Stage 1** of our systematic backlog resolution across all 80,308 undated broadcasts, **Batch 8** resolves an additional **50 broadcasts** from Edward R. Murrow's *This I Believe* on CBS Radio (Sequences 516 through 565).
This installment features some of the most influential minds and cultural pioneers of the twentieth century.
